intro: Click on a mash tun to open its control panel.
firstBrew: That wasn't so easy, was it?
Don't worry, keep earning points to access the shop where you can buy some tools to assist in the process.
feedbackUnder: This batch is too strong. Try adding more water next time.
feedbackOver: This batch is too diluted. You added too much water. Try again!
feedbackPerfect: Excellent! The water level was perfect and the flavour is well balanced.
shopUnlocked: You've earned enough points to purchase an upgrade.
Click on the shop icon to view the instruments for sale.
installedWaterSensor: You've successfully installed the water level sensor.
This tool will allow you to view the precise water level as the mash tun fills.
This should help a lot! Try brewing another batch to see the sensor in action.
